name: raising-engine
description: Schedule-based raising simulation engine — validated data and deterministic headless core

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-types.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-schemas.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs && node scripts/build-native-addon.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/contracts/*.test.mjs tests/validation/*.test.mjs tests/core/*.test.mjs tests/runtime/*.test.mjs tests/player/controller.test.mjs tests/studio/editor.test.mjs tests/mcp/workspace.test.mjs tests/mcp/stdio.test.mjs tests/release/year.test.mjs tests/analysis/analysis.test.mjs tests/analysis/mcp.test.mjs tests/visual/visual.test.mjs tests/visual/hierarchy.test.mjs tests/gameplay/*.test.mjs tests/journey/legacy-save.test.mjs tests/journey/native-parity.test.mjs tests/journey/gameplay-adversarial.test.mjs tests/journey/catalog.test.mjs tests/journey/mcp-conflict.test.mjs tests/journey/editor-batch.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-storage.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-routes.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-pool.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-tree.test.mjs tests/native/addon.test.mjs tests/native/addon-concurrency.test.mjs tests/native/view.test.mjs tests/native/workflow-parity.test.mjs tests/journey/hud-contracts.test.mjs tests/analysis/worker-cache.test.mjs tests/systems/*.test.mjs tests/plugins/host-*.test.mjs
scripts.test:analysis: npm run build && node --test tests/analysis/analysis.test.mjs tests/analysis/mcp.test.mjs tests/analysis/worker-cache.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-routes.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-pool.test.mjs tests/journey/analysis-tree.test.mjs tests/native/addon-concurrency.test.mjs
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build && node --test tests/mcp/workspace.test.mjs tests/mcp/stdio.test.mjs
scripts.build:player: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.player.json && electron-vite build && node scripts/copy-player-resources.mjs
scripts.build:studio: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.studio.json && electron-vite build --config electron.studio.config.ts && node scripts/copy-studio-resources.mjs
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build && electron-vite build --config electron.mcp.config.ts && node scripts/package-mcp.mjs
scripts.package:studio: npm run build:studio && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web && npm run build:native-player && node scripts/package-studio.mjs
scripts.package:windows: npm run package:player && npm run package:studio && node scripts/build-installers.mjs
scripts.test:visual: npm run build:studio && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/visual/*.test.mjs tests/journey/visual-navigation.test.mjs
scripts.test:journey:ui: npm run build:studio && npm run build:web && npm run build:native-player && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/journey/electron.test.mjs tests/journey/polish-editor.test.mjs tests/journey/hud-editor.test.mjs tests/journey/hud-contracts.test.mjs tests/journey/scale-ui.test.mjs tests/journey/web.test.mjs tests/journey/native-ui.test.mjs tests/journey/visual-navigation.test.mjs
scripts.test:native: npm run build && npm run build:wasm && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/native/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:native-player: npm run build && npm run build:native-player && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/native-player/*.test.mjs tests/journey/native-ui.test.mjs tests/journey/native-dropdown.test.mjs
scripts.build:plugin:cutout: node plugins/cutout-animation/tools/build.mjs win wasm studio test && node plugins/cutout-animation/tools/package.mjs
